verdict.rationale: Feitian is a hardware key, so 'self-hosting' typically wouldn't apply, but the evidence shows users can build firmware from Google's OpenSK source and flash it to Feitian's OpenSK hardware, effectively letting a user run their own independent implementation of the 'core product' rather than relying on Feitian's proprietary firmware — a partial form of self-hosting/openness. There's no evidence of self-hosting any server-side/backend component (e.g., an attestation or management server), and no independent corroboration that this OpenSK flashing process works in practice beyond vendor docs. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of OpenSK flashing, self-hostable backend/server components, broader self-hosting documentation beyond one hardware SKU.
